tasks.label: debug-horus
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/devtools/run-horus-debug.sh & while ! nc -z localhost 5678; do sleep 0.2; done && echo 'Horus debugger ready on port 5678' && wait

tasks.label: wait-for-flow-subprocess
tasks.command: while ! nc -z localhost 5679; do sleep 1; done && echo 'Subprocess debugger ready on port 5679'
